company.name: Bekia
company.shortDescription: Bekia is an app that people can use to monetize their daily waste.
company.description: Bekia is an Egyptian technology company providing digital waste management and recycling solutions for businesses. Through its technology platform, Bekia streamlines waste collection, trading, and sustainability reporting, helping organizations maximize the value of recyclable materials while advancing the circular economy.

productsAndServices.description: Bekia offers a service where users can exchange their non-organic waste for goods or services. The process involves separating waste at home, estimating the quantity, and scheduling a pickup through the app.
productsAndServices.name: Waste Collection and Recycling Service

productsAndServices.description: This service focuses on the collection and recycling of electronic waste, allowing users to dispose of their electronic devices responsibly.
productsAndServices.name: Electronic Waste Recycling

productsAndServices.description: Bekia provides a service for collecting used cooking oil from households, preventing improper disposal that can harm the environment.
productsAndServices.name: Cooking Oil Recycling

productsAndServices.description: This service involves the collection of paper waste, including books, newspapers, and other paper products, for recycling.
productsAndServices.name: Paper Recycling

productsAndServices.description: Bekia collects various types of plastic waste for recycling, aiming to reduce plastic pollution.
productsAndServices.name: Plastic Recycling

productsAndServices.description: This service includes the collection and recycling of metal waste, such as aluminum cans and metal containers.
productsAndServices.name: Metal Recycling
